subject: reasoning
question: Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Shirley is sitting second to the right of Leena. Diana is sitting fifth to the right of Shirley. Violet is sitting third to the right of Diana. Abdul is sitting second to the left of Diana. Vikram is sitting third to the left of Leena. Who is sitting between Vikram and Diana?
solution:
The Pattern followed here is:

**Given: **Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the center.

1) Shiley is sitting second to the right of Leena.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c7857fffbe51472d45ad10d31eb10286df17dc37aae856c116f8987f0d0e6d34.png] 

2) Diana is sitting fifth to the right of Shirley.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/67746cad921707ac7e5b67e8f2fe8c7ede390ce604a307b78355178cb47f3b5e.png] 

3) Violet is sitting third to the right of Diana.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6009736dc306a5f9f780861607d52e869b0403306159184fdf730f2b6977c74c.png] 

4) Abdul is sitting second to the left of Diana.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be6d71f57489797b1136f5721d0bc8906e1218653e0cc973b17e9d231c77176a.png] 

5) Vikram is sitting third to the left of Leena.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8404c43e21a3ae23bc6b96f5dd151e7a748e167e3011586c76c4680d2a5718e5.png] 

Clearly, Shirley is sitting between Diana and Vikram.

Hence, the correct answer is "Shirley".
